purpose: Lightweight provenance index of existing execution records and small metadata.

hash_policy.model_artifact_sha256_values_source: Existing command stdout hash records and verified manifests only.
hash_policy.accidental_collection_note: Two GGUF artifact paths were mistakenly included in one Get-FileHash command during collection. That exec call completed but returned no artifact hash values; this index does not use that call for model hashes. The call result does not establish whether any artifact bytes were read. All model hashes in this index come only from previously saved hash stdout records or verified manifests.

comparison.interpretation: Script output status only; the result contains raw-logit differences and is not an equality or quality verdict.

comparison_report_artifacts.invocation_record: No report-builder command record found in the inspected run logs; not reconstructed.

invocation_provenance.provenance: No historical invocation was reconstructed; original source paths and hashes remain recorded.

guard.action: observe-only; no process was killed or stopped

validation_scope.note: T0 runtime and strict-JSON smoke evidence only; semantic quality, CAP, business usefulness, and exact numerical/logit equivalence were not tested by this report. Does not satisfy T1 relabel/new-data prerequisites.

final_update.scope: D-only reproduction index update; no model or GGUF content was read or hashed.
